scripts.build: node scripts/with-build-lock.mjs "ng build --configuration production && npm run generate:sitemap && npm run generate:csp-hashes"
scripts.build:dev: node scripts/with-build-lock.mjs "ng build --configuration development && npm run generate:sitemap"
scripts.build:dev-api: node scripts/with-build-lock.mjs "ng build --configuration dev && npm run generate:sitemap"
scripts.build:staging: node scripts/with-build-lock.mjs "ng build --configuration staging && npm run generate:sitemap"
scripts.build:uat: node scripts/with-build-lock.mjs "ng build --configuration uat && npm run generate:sitemap"
scripts.build:live: node scripts/with-build-lock.mjs "ng build --configuration production && npm run generate:sitemap && npm run generate:csp-hashes"
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.build:clean:dev: npm run clean && npm run build:dev
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.preview:dev: npm run stop:dev && npm run build:dev && npm run serve:static
scripts.preview:dev-api: npm run stop:dev && npm run build:dev-api && npm run serve:static
scripts.preview:staging: npm run stop:dev && npm run build:staging && npm run serve:static
scripts.preview:uat: npm run stop:dev && npm run build:uat && npm run serve:static
scripts.preview:live: npm run stop:dev && npm run build:live && npm run serve:static:live
scripts.preview:clean: npm run clean && npm run preview:live
